name: soybean-admin
description: A clean, elegant, beautiful and powerful admin template, based on Vue3, Vite7, TypeScript, Pinia, NaiveUI and UnoCSS. 一个清新优雅、高颜值且功能强大的后台管理模板，基于最新的前端技术栈，包括 Vue3, Vite8, TypeScript, Pinia, NaiveUI 和 UnoCSS。

issues.title: [功能]: 希望为标签页（Tabs）增加拖拽排序功能，用户可以通过鼠标拖拽调整标签页的顺序
[功能]: 自动生成路由，可以按照一级目录拆分成多个路由文件吗？
[Bug]: 2K显示器下输入框无法正常显示下划线
[功能]: 为原生 Fetch 请求提供统一的 Service URL 构造能力
[Feature] 支持将同一动态路由（不同 params）合并为单个标签页，且该配置需能在 dynamic（后端下发）路由模式下生效

latest_release.name: v2.3.0
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **constants**:
  - export `isDev` environment flag  -  by @Azir-11 [<samp>(dcbc5)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/dcbc53ce)
- **docs**:
  - update Vite version from 7 to 8 in README and package.json  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(788d8)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/788d8929)
  - update communication group details to FeiShu in README  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(da09f)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/da09f2c1)
- **layout**:
  - support mouse wheel horizontal scroll on global tab  -  by @lvlvkeeper [<samp>(3d361)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/3d3613f2)
- **packages**:
  - check git staging area before showing commit prompts  -  by @Azir-11 [<samp>(7b809)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/7b809c09)
- **router**:
  - support `isDev` meta to load routes only in development  -  by @Azir-11 [<samp>(9fc1b)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/9fc1be77)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- **docs**:
  - update FeiShu group image URL with cache-busting query parameter  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(369a3)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/369a3447)
  - restore Star History chart using star-history.dera.page  -  by @OctoBored [<samp>(12854)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/12854ad5)
- **packages**:
  - fix ERR_USE_AFTER_CLOSE error when pressing Ctrl+C during commit  -  by @Azir-11 [<samp>(eba49)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/eba49504)
  - mobile sider stuck at w-0 in production  -  by @wenyuanw [<samp>(c45c4)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/c45c437e)

###    📖 Documentation

- **README**:
  - update FeiShu image URL in README files  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(5297e)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/5297e19b)
- **projects**:
  - align AGENTS.md commit guide with repo conventions  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(02310)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/02310df2)
  - rebrand SoybeanUI to VeanUI and add v3.0 roadmap notes  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(4c563)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/4c563408)
- **v3**:
  - add soybean-admin v3.0 implementation plan document  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(d8e68)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/d8e680d7)
  - update v3 docs  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(37977)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/379772fc)

###    📦 Build

- **projects**: restore the commit-msg hook dropped by the Vite+ migration  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(be9ca)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/be9ca5d9)

###    🏡 Chore

- **.gitignore**: add .codegraph to ignore list  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(4da27)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/4da27aa9)
- **deps**: update deps  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(bb9e0)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/bb9e0989)
- **projects**: regenerate components.d.ts  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(ffbc8)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/ffbc8060)
- **toolchain**: migrate build and lint toolchain to Vite+  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(13f7a)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/13f7a199)

###    🎨 Styles

- **alova**:
  - separate import and export with a blank line  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(ff7c7)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/ff7c76f7)
- **projects**:
  - sort imports with oxc sortImports  -  by @soybeanjs [<samp>(1ba29)</samp>](https://github.com/soybeanjs/soybean-admin/commit/1ba29615)
  - sort imports across src  -  by @s
